name: cic_s1a
_comment: S1a (main temporal): source = 14-15 Feb 2018 capture sessions (flows 0-3,804,158; benign, BruteForce, DoS GoldenEye/Slowloris); embargo 50,000 flows (plus the 12.6 h night gap); deployment = 16 Feb - 2 Mar, 325 windows. Windows 0-33 (16 Feb, DoS with SlowHTTPTest/Hulk) form the S1b DoS pair.

shortcut_policy._comment: Exclude each listed host/OS fingerprint feature whose single-feature AUC on the source train block is >= 0.99; other flagged features stay and are reported; an all-features variant is reported as sensitivity.
